title: Power Man and Iron Fist #81 Marvel 1982 Luke Cage Halwan Denys Cowan Bronze
condition_description: Bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
description:
Power Man and Iron Fist #81 (May 1982), Marvel Comics. Luke Cage and Iron Fist head to Halwan, where Abe Brown is accused of crimes he can't remember; the return of Boris and Ninotchka. Written by Mary Jo Duffy, art by Denys Cowan; cover by Denys Cowan and Joe Rubinstein. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: Gabriel Lone Ranger Western Town ad.

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
